decisions.reason: Accepting the additional through-hole assembly cost does not change the existing obligation to prepare, review, or assist with the JLCPCB order.
The cost exception does not alter the BOM deliverable rules or any component-population attribute represented in this Requirement.
The accepted assembly-cost premium does not change which sensor-board production files must be delivered.
Connector assembly cost has no necessary effect on whether the KiCad project resolves without local-library warnings.
Allowing through-hole connectors despite their cost does not necessarily change the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, or connector-access constraints.
The source decision does not specify any change to sensor-board connector placement, orientation, alignment, or enclosure accessibility.
The development-board cost exception concerns connector assembly and does not change the BOOT button, reset wiring, or capacitor values.
The ESP32 breakout was already required to be through-hole; accepting a higher assembly cost does not modify its style, pitch, placement, or full-pin-access requirement.
The source permits a through-hole cost premium but does not itself change the interboard connector families, pin counts, pinouts, or topology represented here.
The connector cost exception does not necessarily alter the main board's dimensions, connector placement, orientation, or enclosure-fit constraints.
Accepting the added assembly cost does not change the battery connector's location, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The cost exception does not change the required sensor modules, connector families, connector count, supplies, or interface pinouts.
